label: Before choosing a card, hand still holds its pre-shuffle count
Before choosing a card, deck still holds its original count
Choosing a hand card removes it from hand
The chosen card is shuffled into the deck (deck grows by one)
Declining ends the loop: exactly one card (the count chosen) is drawn back out of the deck
The drawn card lands in MEMORY, not hand -- hand count stays at 4 while memory grows by exactly one
Hand is unaffected by the final draw -- it goes to memory, not hand
